integrity: Proof establishes all n>=3; two standalone exact-integer Python verification programs provide finite corroboration, not independent formal certification.
scientific_limitations: The first-zero multiplicity count is an explicit lower bound, not complete; odd-width total convolution nullity is not classified. The model includes all partial matchings of K_(3,n) with unit weights. External priority may be incomplete.
title: Sharp first Walsh-zero threshold for partial matchings of \(K_{3,n}\)
